types.name: fact
types.description: specific data lookup (what score, how many, which method, what article says)

types.name: overview
types.description: broad coverage, summarization (summarize, explain, what is this about, main content)

types.name: reference
types.description: asks about a specific table/figure/equation/clause by number or label

types.name: exploratory
types.description: open exploration, comparison (tell me about X, explain X, compare, what are the implications)

label_instruction: If reference type, extract the label normalized to English (e.g., 'Table 1', 'Figure 2', 'Article 30'). Handle any language: '表1' → 'Table 1', '图2' → 'Figure 2', '第三十条' → 'Article 30'. null if no reference.
